title: Vending Services Program Standard for Cashless Acceptance and Failed-Vend Refunds
content:
Whether a card reader is fitted to each machine, whether employees may pay by mobile wallet at the machine, the card processing charge deducted before commission, the window within which an employee refund is made after a failed vend and the ceiling on a single failed-vend refund are fixed by the programme the Vending Services Program agreement is written at.

| Programme | Card reader fitted to each machine | Mobile wallet accepted at the machine | Card processing charge deducted before commission | Calendar days after a failed vend within which a refund is made | Ceiling on one failed-vend refund |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Single Machine Snack Service | no | no | 3.10 | 7 | 5.00 |
| Snack & Cold Beverage Bank | yes | yes | 2.95 | 10 | 6.00 |
| Combination Vending Bank | yes | yes | 2.80 | 14 | 8.00 |
| Fresh Food Vending Service | yes | yes | 2.65 | 14 | 12.00 |
| Campus Vending Network Service | yes | yes | 2.45 | 21 | 12.00 |
| Managed Vending & Kiosk Service | yes | yes | 2.35 | 30 | 18.00 |

The card processing charge is a percentage and is deducted before commission. The refund window is counted in calendar days from the failed vend. The refund ceiling is an amount in US dollars and applies to a single failed-vend refund.

### Reading the two refund figures

The window and the ceiling constrain a refund in different ways, and both hold at once. The window is a matter of when: on the Combination Vending Bank, where the window is 14 calendar days, a refund made on the fourteenth day after the failed vend falls within the window, and one made on the fifteenth day does not. The ceiling is a matter of how much: on the same programme, where the ceiling is 8.00, a failed vend of 8.00 is refundable to its full amount, and a failed vend above 8.00 is refundable only up to 8.00, since no single failed-vend refund exceeds the ceiling printed against the programme.

### Card acceptance across the schedule

Only the Single Machine Snack Service is written without a card reader fitted to each machine and without mobile wallet acceptance; the other five programmes carry both. The card processing charge falls as the programme grows, from 3.10 on the Single Machine Snack Service to 2.35 on the Managed Vending & Kiosk Service, and it is stated as a charge taken before commission rather than after it.
